text:
aaliyah: Quick async check — where are we on SKU inventory, rack power verification, and the allocation matrix for the next Dedicated cluster? Need final numbers to lock reservations by EOD Friday.

marco: Inventory: 48x A100-80GB, 32x H100, 16x T4 spare cards (on order). Still waiting on 8x H100 from vendor; PR#4205 in procurement. ETA from vendor is 6/7.

dani: Rack power: measured PDUs on site yesterday. 6 racks pass, 2 racks failing imbalance threshold (rack-11, rack-12). Eng-infra scheduled remediation Thursday AM.

morgan: Quick question — do we need to reserve the H100s for canary vs production pools separately? That affects how we tag allocations in the capacity sheet.

prashant: Yes, canary should use H100-2x config (2 cards per node) for latency testing. Prod can use mixed A100/H100. I'll update the allocation recommendations doc.

marco: Pushing current inventory snapshot:```
sku,qty,location,status
A100-80GB,48,warehouse,available
H100,32,staging,28 available / 8 on-order
T4,16,warehouse,spares
```

aaliyah: Thx Marco. @dani can you own the rack-11/12 remediation and confirm power headroom after fix? We can't seat H100s in those racks until confirmed.

dani: Yep. I'll run the balance script and post results. Owning remediation and retest. ETA Thursday 11:30 PT.

ryan: Network/BMC: we still need IPAM entries + BMC creds for 24 nodes. Ops-bot ticket created https://tickets.redwood/INF-7823 — needs whoever is provisioning the nodes to attach ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-7823 created by ryan, status: open, assignees: eng-infra-provisioning. Last update: awaiting node hostnames.

morgan: On allocation tagging: I'll create two tags in the capacity sheet: "canary-h100" and "prod-mixed" and add an owner column. Will ping when done.

prashant: Procurement update: vendor confirmed partial shipments next week. If we prioritize the 8 H100s to canary racks, we can start canary validation earlier. We should decide allocation by EOD Fri.

aaliyah: Decision: prioritize 8 H100s to canary racks if rack power remediated; rest go to prod mixed pool. Owners: @dani (rack remediation & signoff), @ryan (IPAM/BMC entries & ticket attach), @morgan (capacity tags + allocation sheet), @prashant (procurement ETA and vendor hold).

marco: FYI running quick capacity calc: with 48 A100 + 32 H100 we can support ~1200 concurrent gen tokens at target p99. If we lose 8 H100s to delay, estimate drops ~15%.

aaliyah: Good to know. One more ask: CI/CD owners — can we prioritize the canary model rollout next week once nodes are up? Need a two-day window for perf/regen tests.

prashant: noted — I'll block a window with runtime and ml-eng.

morgan: Completed capacity tags and added an "allocation_decision" column + owners. Link: https://docs.redwood/capacity/next-dedicated.

dani: Rack remediation done, ran balance script, posted output: everything within tolerance now. Will revalidate after nodes are racked.

aaliyah: Awesome — can everyone update the sheet and ticket by EOD? I'll compile and send final reservation request to finance. :thumbsup:

marco: Updated inventory with staging holds.

ryan: IPAM entries created for 24 nodes, attached hostnames to INF-7823.

ops-bot: Reminder: INF-7823 has not changed status in 6h — please add notes or update assignee if work is complete.

aaliyah: Closing ask for now — will post follow-up after finance confirms reservations. Thanks all. :rocket:
